title: Diffusion Bonding Fixture for Combustion Chamber 01
description:
A concave fixture was fabricated for diffusion bonding of the copper inner layer
and steel outer skin. The steel outer-skin article was blow
formed and the maximum gas pressure was 7 MPa, according to FEM analysis.

This shows a forming die and examples of formed steel outer skins.
author: Romanusas2
